```{python}
#| label: gwas-workflow-setup
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
from bioreport.software import software_records
from bioreport.config import load_project_metadata

workflow_config = load_project_metadata()
```

The data in this report comes from the **GWASFlow** genome-wide association pipeline (GEMMA LMM mixed-model route). The diagram below shows the complete chain from input gating to delivery; actual executed steps and software versions follow the upstream audit logs.

## Pipeline

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-gwas-pipeline
%%| fig-cap: "GWASFlow analysis pipeline"
%%| fig-width: 12

%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': {'primaryColor': '#E3F2FD', 'primaryTextColor': '#2c3e50', 'lineColor': '#7f8c8d', 'fontFamily': 'Helvetica'}}}%%

graph LR
    A[Input Gate] --> B[Genotype<br>Normalization]
    B --> C[Four-stage<br>Genotype QC]
    C --> D1[LD Pruning + PCA<br>Population Structure]
    C --> D2[Trait Input<br>Preparation]
    D1 --> E[Cohort Kinship K<br>-gk 1]
    D2 --> F[GEMMA LMM<br>Association -lmm 1]
    E --> F
    F --> G[Harmonization +<br>Bonferroni]
    G --> H[Locus Definition]
    H --> I[Regional LD]
    G --> J[Plots + Delivery]
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon=false}
**Model**

Association testing uses the GEMMA linear mixed model (LMM): the cohort-wide centered kinship matrix K (GEMMA `-gk 1`) corrects for population structure and relatedness; covariates comprise the intercept and the trait-declared PCs (from PCA on the LD-pruned marker set, `n_pcs` declared per trait). For selfing/inbreeding plants, HWE filtering is disabled by default and highly related materials are not automatically removed.
:::

## Software Versions

```{python}
#| label: tbl-gwas-software
#| output: asis
records = software_records(workflow_config)
frame = pd.DataFrame(records)
if not frame.empty:
    display(Markdown('| Software | Version | Source |\n|---|---|---|\n' + '\n'.join(
        f"| {row.get('Software','')} | {row.get('Version','')} | {row.get('Source','')} |"
        for _, row in frame.iterrows())))
else:
    display(Markdown('Software versions not registered (software_versions missing).'))
```
